note: Removes the setAccessControlsApply action and its afterMount call; accessControlsApply becomes a reducer whose default reads the flag from getAppContext.
pinned_connect_host now returns a target with host and tls_server_name; the source uses both directly and drops the unbracket_host import and string comparison.
Event::headers now takes the Context and returns CapturedEventHeaders; the custom Vec<(String,String)> header builder and its tests are deleted.
Adds an _expire_change_request helper (set EXPIRED, save, log, notify on commit) and both PENDING and stale-APPROVED branches call it with their message.
Moves recording-api and recording-rasterizer out of the ingestion sessionreplay tree to top-level nodejs/src directories and updates imports; shared helpers still imported from ingestion.
Deletes the opensearch profile entries from docker-compose.profiles.yml and adds the profiles to docker-compose.dev.yml.
Deletes the pinner's private _is_action and imports a shared is_action_key from parity/eligibility.py, which the commit adds there.
Removes the local SIGNAL_SOURCE_REQUIRED_TABLES and the intent-based CI table branch from the panel, moving setup into a DataSourceSetup keyed by signal source; merged map not shown.
Regenerates OPS HCL from dumps: drops column_aliases and adds an error filter; queries stay inline strings with no file-reading mechanism.
Replaces the raw api.create batch_check call with the generated llmAnalyticsSummarizationBatchCheckCreate client and drops the semgrep suppression.
